resources.string: Before starting, ask the user «Which space are you in?» naming: %1$s, or here (just the phone). Do not start until they answer; then call meditation start again with place.
Say EXACTLY this, slowly and softly, adding nothing and asking nothing: «%1$s»
Say EXACTLY this meditation cue, slowly and in a soft voice, adding nothing (no greeting, no question): «%1$s»
A %1$s session is already running, %2$d min left. Ask whether to stop it.
Meditation paused. Tell the user in a few words; they can say «continue» to go on.
Meditation resumed. Say only «Let\'s go on» and nothing else.
Let\'s do %1$d minutes of %2$s. Get comfortable and close your eyes if you like.
Let\'s do %1$d minutes of %2$s in %3$s. Get comfortable and close your eyes if you like.
Let\'s do %1$d minutes of %2$s here, just with the phone. Get comfortable and close your eyes if you like.
We\'re done. Gently move your fingers, take a deep breath and open your eyes whenever you\'re ready.
We\'re done. Stay just like this, resting. Sleep well.
All right, we\'ll stop here. Take a moment before getting up.
I couldn\'t start the music, so we\'ll go on without it.
Guided sessions and breathing: «%1$s, meditate with me for 10 minutes».
%1$s opens and closes; the cues in between use this voice. If %1$s is offline, the phone takes over.
Dims the lights that are on in your space to a warm glow and puts them back exactly as they were.
Calm music on your space\'s speaker, or on the phone.

string-array.name: meditation_478_intro
string-array.item: Sit or lie down comfortably. Let your shoulders drop and your breathing settle.
We\'ll breathe four, seven, eight. Breathe in through your nose for four, hold for seven, and breathe out slowly through your mouth for eight.

string-array.name: meditation_478_body
string-array.item: Breathe in, two, three, four. Hold… and let the air out slowly, all the way to eight.
Follow the circle on the screen if it helps: it grows as you breathe in, stops while you hold and shrinks as you breathe out.
Notice how each breath out is a little longer and softer.
If you feel a bit dizzy, breathe normally for a moment and come back when you like.
Let your body grow heavier with every breath out.
A few more breaths at your own pace: four, seven, eight.

string-array.name: meditation_478_reminders
string-array.item: Breathe in for four, hold for seven, out for eight.
If your mind wanders, just go back to counting.
Shoulders loose, jaw relaxed.
Breathe out slowly, no hurry.

string-array.name: meditation_box_intro
string-array.item: Find a comfortable position, back straight and shoulders loose.
We\'ll do box breathing: in for four, hold for four, out for four, and wait four with empty lungs.

string-array.name: meditation_box_body
string-array.item: In, two, three, four. Hold, two, three, four. Out, two, three, four. Wait, two, three, four.
Imagine drawing a square, one side for each count.
Keep the same pace on all four sides, calm and even.
If you run short of air, make the box a little smaller, three counts each.
Notice the calm each turn of the square leaves behind.

string-array.name: meditation_box_reminders
string-array.item: In four, hold four, out four, wait four.
If you get distracted, go back to the first side of the square.
Breathe evenly, without forcing.

string-array.name: meditation_scan_intro
string-array.item: Lie down or sit comfortably, and close your eyes if you like.
Take three slow breaths and let your body rest its whole weight.

string-array.name: meditation_scan_body
string-array.item: Bring your attention to your feet. Notice their weight and warmth, without changing anything.
Move up to your ankles and calves. If there is tension, let it loosen as you breathe out.
Now your knees and thighs. Let them soften a little more.
Notice your hips and lower back resting.
Bring your attention to your belly. Feel it rise and fall with your breath.
Move up to your chest and upper back. Let them open with each breath in.
Now your hands, arms and shoulders. Let them drop.
Notice your neck and jaw. Part your teeth slightly and relax your tongue.
Relax your face: your eyes, your forehead and your scalp.
Now feel your whole body at once, breathing calmly.

string-array.name: meditation_scan_reminders
string-array.item: If your mind drifts, gently come back to the part of the body you were on.
Breathe slowly and let each breath out release a little more.
There is nothing to do right or wrong, just notice.

string-array.name: meditation_sleep_intro
string-array.item: Lie down the way you usually sleep and let the bed hold you.
Breathe slowly: in through your nose, and let the air out more slowly than it came in.

string-array.name: meditation_sleep_body
string-array.item: With every breath out, let your body sink a little deeper.
Relax your forehead, your eyes and your jaw.
Let your shoulders drop and relax your arms and hands.
Feel your chest and belly moving on their own, without effort.
Relax your legs and feet. Your whole body is heavy and warm.
If a thought comes, let it drift by like a cloud and go back to your breath.
There is nothing else to do. Just rest.

string-array.name: meditation_sleep_reminders
string-array.item: Breathe in softly… and let the air out slowly.
Each breath takes you a little closer to rest.
Everything is fine. You can let the day go.

string-array.name: meditation_mindful_intro
string-array.item: Sit comfortably, back straight but not stiff, and close your eyes if you like.
Take a deep breath and let it out slowly.

string-array.name: meditation_mindful_body
string-array.item: Bring your attention to your breath, the air coming in and out of your nose.
Don\'t try to change it. Just watch it as it is.
Notice the sounds around you, without judging them, and come back to your breath.
Notice the sensations in your body: the support, the temperature, your clothes against your skin.
If thoughts come, name them silently, thinking, and come back to the air.
Rest in this moment, breath after breath.

string-array.name: meditation_mindful_reminders
string-array.item: If you got distracted, that\'s fine. Kindly come back to your breath.
Breathing in, I know I\'m breathing in. Breathing out, I know I\'m breathing out.
Just this moment, just this breath.
Let your shoulders go and breathe.
